description: Abstract schema for synthesized ancestor-grouping relationship objects derived from entity naming conventions. Ancestor relationships are never stored as real entities; they are synthesized at query time by the data access layer when a traverse-relationships entry of type 'ancestor' is requested. An ancestor relationship object will never have 'entity' in its entity-types array.

child.description: The entity whose name contains this ancestor as a prefix

names.description: The name prefix segments that identify this ancestor grouping key
